Metadata.Title: Prey
Metadata.Name: 1620p (PS4 Pro mode)
Metadata.Note: 2880x1620 output and render in PS4 Pro mode instead of 2560x1440, without the dynamic frame buffer downscale (minimum scale 1.0), WriteCombined heap +512 MiB, r_Width/r_Height fixed at 2880x1620 (in-world touch screens). Enable only one resolution entry. Requires NeoEnabler 0.5.0 or later (PreyDll.prx entries).
Metadata.Author: gasb07
